_about: Assets borrowed from the owner's CAPY GO BOOM for the Capy Go Boom mini-game (src/server/World/Props/CapyGoBoom.luau). 'grant' are the owner's own (user 11690979745): the game must be allowed to use them or other players see no capybara; tools/asset_permissions.py grants them to the game (Universe, Use) along with everything else.
